correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs exact Dirichlet(1^n) gap density from a uniformly selected marked site, verifies geodesic midpoints, and derives odd invertibility with Jacobian 2^{-(n-1)}. In even n the alternating constraint and explicit affine fiber are necessary and sufficient. The triangular Jacobian 2^{-(n-2)} and exact integration over conditional parameter T prove the density and conditional uniformity. A standalone exact rational checker reproduced 4812 deterministic tests for n=3..14. Finite tests are not used as infinite proof.
